title: fix(console): audit log reads the grid's clock; zh-CN settings page uses full-width punctuation
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xLNzNfNPdGDtmtFwGRvTx78)_

Part of #32158

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 审计日志的时间列改用一个共享的时间戳格式(和表格单元格同一套 12 小时制，精确到秒，按工作区声明的时区显示);设置页上 6 条中文提示里的半角冒号、逗号改成全角。
- **为什么改:** 中文界面里表格显示「2026/11/10 上午7:03」，审计日志却显示 24 小时制「2026/11/10 07:24:26」，同一语言两套时钟，且审计日志不认工作区时区;设置页的中文句子里夹着半角标点。
- **风险与回滚:** 英文显示逐字不变;德文审计日志从 24 小时制变为 12 小时制(德文表格单元格本来就是 12 小时制)，这是刻意改动的断言。纯前端，revert 即回滚。
- **先看:** `ui/packages/core/src/utils/date-display.ts`(新函数 `formatDateTimeStamp`)、`ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/AuditLogPage.tsx`、`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh-Hans.ts` 的 6 行。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/consoleFaces.displayLocale-9909.test.tsx apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsView.i18n-4024.test.tsx`，预期全部通过;在 `origin/main` 的源码上分别有 3 例、5 例失败。
- **需要你做的:** 无，等席位审核后由席位落地。

## What changes

- `ui/packages/core/src/utils/date-display.ts`: new export `formatDateTimeStamp(value, options?)`, the timestamp face. It is the grid's compact convention (numeric date, `hour12: true`, the declared display zone) to the second: `3/4/2020, 3:30:00 PM` in en, `2020/3/4 下午3:30:00` in zh-CN. It is its own function, not a new `formatDateTime` `style` value, because a field's authored `format` reaches that `style` key (`temporalCellText` in `plugin-grid`), so a new value there would be a new metadata spelling.
- `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/AuditLogPage.tsx`: the timestamp column (row and side panel) draws through `formatDateTimeStamp` instead of a bare `toLocaleString(locale)`. That bare call took the 24-hour `Intl` default in zh-CN and ignored the declared display zone.
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh-Hans.ts`: six `console.settingsView` values use full-width `：` / `，` (`lockedByEnv`, `envLockBadgeTitle`, `cryptoRefusalSubjectSuffix`, `cryptoRefusalNoSubject`, `cryptoRefusalToast`, `unsupportedSpecifierType`). Values edited in place; no key added, removed or moved.
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh-Hant.ts`: regenerated from `zh-Hans.ts` (`pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n gen:zh-hant`), so the same six values carry the full-width marks in Traditional Chinese; nothing else in the file moves.
- `.changeset/zh-cn-settings-punctuation-audit-clock.md`: `patch` on `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/console`.

**Deliberate assertion change:** `consoleFaces.displayLocale-9909.test.tsx` pinned the audit column's de-DE face as `4.3.2020, 15:30:00`; it now reads `4.3.2020, 3:30:00 PM`, because the shared face is 12-hour in every locale, as the grid's compact face already is in de-DE cells. The en pin (`3/4/2020, 3:30:00 PM`) is unchanged.

## Where the rest of #32158 lands

Step 0 classified every item by where its fix lands (seat rulings on the card thread). Only the two items above land in `ui/**` and are built here.

| Item | Owner |
|:---|:---|
| Object-extension label "Accounts (Success Overlay)" | No change: it is the showcase's authored `objectExtensions` override, which beats the catalog in every locale by design (ADR-0029 D9.2a; already ruled on #29675 / #29679) |
| Notification titles ("Approval requested") | #32218 (`domain:server`: plugin-approvals renders keyed text at emit in the recipient's or deployment locale) |
| Home activity text ("Dev Admin Created Repair Ticket …") | #32218 (`domain:server`: plugin-audit serves codeless `sys_activity` rows as written) |
| Language name in "当前为English、美国" | Stays on #32158, behind #32021, which holds `FirstRunChecklist.tsx`: name the locale with `Intl.DisplayNames` in `describeValue`, as `currencyName` does for currency |
| Dashboard KPI subtitles ("Projects", "Tasks", "Total Budget") | #32219 (`examples/**`: the showcase bundle lacks zh-CN `datasets.*.measures.*.label` for three measures) |
| "Metadata Commit" object label | #32218 (`packages/platform-objects`: `SysMetadataCommitObject` is missing from the i18n extract config) |
| Auth settings punctuation, server half | #32218 (`domain:server`: `service-settings` zh-CN `auth` namespace) |

## Tests

Both fixes were reproduced on `origin/main` first: the new pins were run with each fixed source restored to `main`.

<details><summary>Settings page, main sources: 5 failed / 10 passed</summary>

```
× SETTINGS_LOCKED toast: zh-CN joins the key with a full-width colon; en is unchanged
× crypto refusal, located: zh-CN toast and panel sentence are full-width; en is unchanged
× crypto refusal, unlocated: the zh-CN panel sentence is full-width; en is unchanged
× env-lock chip title: zh-CN is full-width; en is unchanged
× unsupported specifier row: zh-CN joins the type with a full-width colon; en is unchanged
Expected: "已被环境变量锁定：timezone"
Received: "已被环境变量锁定:timezone"
Tests  5 failed | 10 passed (15)
```

</details>

<details><summary>Audit log, main sources: 3 failed / 12 passed</summary>

```
× 'AuditLogPage — timestamp column' — says the de-DE faces under a de-DE session
× zh-CN: the timestamp is the 12-hour face to the second, not the 24-hour Intl default
× the timestamp is drawn in the declared display zone, not the machine's
Tests  3 failed | 12 passed (15)
```

The en audit pins pass on `main` too: they are the preservation half.

</details>

<details><summary>This branch: 34 / 34</summary>

```
pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/date-display.timestampFace-32158.test.ts apps/console/src/pages/consoleFaces.displayLocale-9909.test.tsx apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsView.i18n-4024.test.tsx
Test Files  3 passed (3)
     Tests  34 passed (34)
```

</details>

Every pin switches the locale on the real page: the settings pins type into a field and click Save (or render the served namespace) under zh and then en; the audit pins mount the page under zh-CN, en and de-DE through `LocalizationProvider`, and once with a declared `Asia/Shanghai` zone.

## Acceptance notes

- About 70 other zh-CN strings in `zh-Hans.ts` put half-width punctuation beside Chinese (connect-agent, list errors, detail toolbar, dashboard config and others). Out of scope by the seat's ruling; not changed here.
- `ApprovalsInboxPage` and `FlowRunsPage` still format their own timestamps with `toLocaleString(locale)`. They are not the surface the card names; not changed here.
- "Dec 10" without a year is `formatDate`'s deliberate current-year face (`keepYear` is the opt-in, objectui#13331), so it is not changed.

## Verification

Every gate `dispatch-gates --commands` derives for this diff (36 commands, re-derived after merging `main`) exits 0, plus `check-sdui-manifest`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:commit-card-trailers`, the `ui/scripts` suite and `check:new-line-citations` (0 new); the seat holds the per-command record for head `0a6f40c6`; at `b24d94f5`, which adds only the regenerated `zh-Hant.ts`, `zh-hant-generated.test.ts` passes 9/9. `@object-ui/core` type-check (both programs) passes locally; the Console's type-check is left to CI's `Type Check UI`.
